title: Cosmo Matassa and documenting history while living
summary: The interviewer relays Cosmo's remarks about being too busy making a living for history; Tex stresses documenting history and not wasting time.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant
